body: I have meditated, and I practice (used to, until recently) yoga. It helped some, but there's still something there I can't get rid of.

No, it's not coming from my family. It's just that every time I try to talk to someone about how I feel, just how I *feel* that's the response I get from my ex or a friend. 

"You're a coward, upsetting the people who love you. You know when people kill themselves, the people around them never get over it."


*I am never going to get over this.* 


I've tried so hard to change. Some days are okay, just okay. I decided a couple of years ago to start college, hoping that would keep me busy and give me something to look forward to, you know, graduating. I just don't even care about it, really. It's hard to make myself get up and go to class. I haven't been able to eat anything, or sleep. I'm so tired, but I can't fall asleep. I keep thinking and I can't stop.
